text:
alex: quick heads-up — PR #3129 has a couple of small naming + fmt nits. hoping to get it in before Fri merge window. @marcus can you do a quick pass? i can squash fixups now.

marcus: on it. which files? a quick path would help.

alex: main change is in pkg/kvcache/kvstore.go — variable `ctx` used inconsistently with our new `requestCtx` convention. golangci flagged: 
```
pkg/kvcache/kvstore.go:42:3: stutters: receiver name ctx should not be ctx (golint)
pkg/serving/router.go:12:1: file is not gofmted (gofmt)
```

marcus: ugh, forgot we landed that convention. can you paste the small diff you mentioned? if it's just renames+format, i can approve after CI.

alex: diff (very small):
```diff
- func (s *Store) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (Value, error) {
+ func (s *Store) Get(requestCtx context.Context, key string) (Value, error) {
     // ...
 }
```

sue: also seeing a `go fmt` failure on pkg/serving/router.go from an earlier commit — ci will block until that's fixed. run `gofmt -w` or `gofmt -s -w`.

ci-bot: golangci-lint report: 2 issues found — naming (stutter) and gofmt. blocking: true.

marcus: :thumbsup: i'll comb through and push a tiny commit that renames vars and runs gofmt. alex — want me to push to your branch or make a followup PR?

alex: push to my branch please, faster. i've enabled edits by maintainers.

marcus: pushed fixup (branch: alex/pr-3129-fix-names) — ran gofmt, renamed `ctx` -> `requestCtx`, removed a redundant var shadowing `err`. CI re-running.

ci-bot: CI status: checks running...

ci-bot: CI status: checks passing ✅ (golangci-lint OK, unit tests OK)

alex: thanks! merging during Friday slot unless anyone objects.

sue: no objections. :rocket:
